definition: Strategy definition, sample window and gates frozen before results are seen; commit hash is the registration
pass_criteria: Commit hash recorded before evaluation window opens; variant count counted including abandoned variants
demotion_trigger: Fails if any variant added after seeing results

definition: Enough bets to separate skill from variance
pass_criteria: 300-bet minimum for provisional listing; ~2,243 bets to prove 55% skill at 80% power

definition: Result survives multiple-testing correction over the number of variants tested
Out-of-sample test on held-out seasons (train/validation/final holdout split)
pass_criteria: Holdout win rate with game-cluster lower bound above break-even

definition: Measured against a verified timestamped closing/operator price
pass_criteria: De-vigged CLV positive with confidence interval
demotion_trigger: No verified price history (market columns blank)

definition: Multi-leg combos use empirically validated joint probability, not independent multiplication
pass_criteria: Joint probability validated; void/push rules documented
demotion_trigger: Legs priced as independent under dependence

definition: Maximum drawdown and fractional-Kelly staking within limits
pass_criteria: Max drawdown within bankroll tolerance; Kelly fraction capped

definition: Staking sized by fractional Kelly, not flat ROI chasing
pass_criteria: Staking rule documented and applied consistently

definition: Price source is a verified operator snapshot with timestamp
pass_criteria: Closing line from an operator snapshot, not an aggregator

definition: Parlays/prop combos only behind joint-evidence gate
pass_criteria: Validated joint probability + void/push rules both available

definition: Bet settlement follows operator house rules (OT counts, push refund, postponed void)
Market can absorb the proposed stake at the quoted price
No cash payouts; competition is points-only until jurisdiction/funding decided
demotion_trigger: Real money introduced without jurisdiction review
